details: Bitcoin's price has experienced a decline of over 2% in the last 24 hours, trading around $61,200. This downturn is attributed to significant selling pressure, negative inflows, and broader macroeconomic concerns, including rising US inflation forecasts. Additionally, there are indications of capital shifting from crypto towards artificial intelligence (AI) investments, further contributing to Bitcoin's underperformance.
title: Bitcoin Dips as Macro Headwinds & AI Shift Impact Market

details: Wallets associated with the Humanity Protocol have been exploited, resulting in the loss of over $32 million. Following the incident, the protocol's native token experienced a drastic plunge of 89%. This event underscores persistent security vulnerabilities and risks within the decentralized finance (DeFi) ecosystem.
title: Humanity Protocol Wallets Drained for Over $32 Million in Exploit

details: Morpho, a decentralized finance (DeFi) lending protocol, has successfully concluded a funding round, raising $175 million. The investment was co-led by prominent crypto venture firms Paradigm, a16z crypto, and Ribbit Capital, and the funds will be utilized to further develop an "open credit network."
title: DeFi Protocol Morpho Secures $175M to Build Open Credit Network

details: Despite a recent drop in Ethereum's price towards the $1,600 level, BitMine has reportedly acquired an additional 75,000 ETH, valued at approximately $123 million. This significant purchase brings BitMine's total Ethereum holdings closer to 5.62 million ETH, nearing its targeted 5% of the total supply, even amidst ongoing ETF outflows and broader market uncertainty.
title: BitMine Continues Accumulating Ethereum Despite Price Dip
